title: Fix: ikm_buf double-free in ioctl_do_kdf out_free_okm
description:
In src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c, the out_free_okm label frees ikm_buf without setting ikm_buf = NULL. goto out_zero then unconditionally checks if (ikm_buf) and frees it again.

Fix: after every kfree(ikm_buf) in the out_free_okm block, add ikm_buf = NULL. There is exactly one kfree(ikm_buf) in that block — the fix is a one-liner.

Verify: after the fix, trace all four paths that reach out_free_okm with a non-NULL ikm_buf (fd not UNSET, inbuf_len > 0, lookup fails, no kdf callback, fips_gate fails, iterations < min, salt_len < min, okm_buf alloc fails) and confirm that out_zero finds ikm_buf == NULL in each case.

Test: write a userspace test that opens /dev/crypto2dev, calls INIT to make it an OPERATION fd, then calls DO_KDF with a valid ikm_fd. Should return -ENODEV cleanly. Run under KASAN to confirm no heap double-free.
